$comment: Per-scene limits for scripts/visual/compare.mjs. A scene fails when a metric exceeds its limit. 'default' applies to every scene; 'scenes' overrides single keys per scene (<page>__<state>__<theme>). Metrics: mad / grid / gridMasked are 0..1, pctOver is percent of pixels, cellsOver counts of 256 grid cells. A page agent ratchets its scenes DOWN as the page converges; never raise a limit to hide a regression. missing: 'warn' lists scenes present on one side only, 'fail' fails the run.
